summary: This is an Item 8.01 Other Events filing by Sadot Group Inc. reporting that Nasdaq confirmed the company regained compliance with Listing Rule 5250(c)(1) after filing its delinquent 10-K. The filing does not announce or relate to any special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or management change. It is a routine compliance update.
